item.description: The NotifyNextcloud class fails to properly initialize when targets parameter is missing or empty. Tests like test_plugin_nextcloud_groups_errors_and_dedup and test_plugin_nextcloud_persistent_storage fail because the class doesn't handle missing targets correctly.
item.contract: When NotifyNextcloud is initialized without targets or with empty targets, it should properly handle the initialization and not fail during construction. The class should validate targets parameter and set default behavior appropriately.

item.description: The NotifyResend constructor requires a from_email parameter but doesn't enforce it properly during initialization. The test test_plugin_resend_edge_cases fails with TypeError: NotifyResend.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'from_email'
item.contract: The NotifyResend constructor must properly validate and require the from_email parameter during initialization. It should raise TypeError with descriptive message if from_email is not provided or invalid.

item.description: The URL parsing logic in NotifyNextcloud incorrectly handles user targets in test_plugin_nextcloud_urls. The expected vs actual URL format shows that user targets are not being properly encoded or formatted with '@' prefixes.
item.contract: The url() method in NotifyNextcloud should properly format user targets with '@' prefix when generating privacy URLs, matching the expected format 'ncloud://user:****@localhost/@user1/@user2' instead of 'ncloud://user:****@localhost/user1/user2'

item.description: The NotifySendGrid class has issues with attachment functionality in test_plugin_sendgrid_urls. The test expects notification to succeed but fails due to improper attachment handling or request flow.
item.contract: The NotifySendGrid class must properly support attachment functionality and ensure successful notification delivery when attachments are provided.

item.description: Mock expectations in test_plugin_nextcloud.py are not properly configured for caching and group resolution tests. Specifically, test_plugin_nextcloud_json_empty_returns_empty and test_plugin_nextcloud_caching_group_and_all fail because mocked HTTP calls don't return expected counts for get calls.
item.contract: When using mocked HTTP calls in NotifyNextcloud, the mock objects should correctly track and return expected counts for get calls during caching and group resolution scenarios.
